name: rays-job-prep-package
description: AI-agent tools for a tech job search: resume + LinkedIn review, recruiter and startup-founder outreach with Sales Navigator, and a hiring-post monitor that collects people saying 'my team is hiring', and Simplify-assisted job applications with an answer bank.

plugins.name: resume-linkedin-review
plugins.description: Step 1: sharpen resume bullets and audit/update your LinkedIn, truthfully and with your approval. Outputs candidate-profile.md.

plugins.name: linkedin-recruiter-outreach
plugins.description: Step 2: find, research and draft personalized outreach to tech recruiters (Sales Navigator) and to founders of hiring YC/seed-stage startups, with a launcher page and progress checklist. Drafts only; you review and send.

plugins.name: hiring-monitor
plugins.description: Step 3: every ~6h, find people at your target companies posting 'my team is hiring', keep them in a leads list for outreach, and flag new matching jobs. Never contacts anyone.

plugins.name: job-applications
plugins.description: Step 5: fill job applications in Chrome with the Simplify extension, answer leftover questions from your verified profile and a growing answer bank, and stop for your review before Submit.
